name: Existing survey archives may constrain cold circumstellar dissipation
summary: The paper proposes reinterpreting DEBRIS, DUNES and SONS and using Planck, JCMT, ALMA and NOEMA archives to constrain or search for cold waste heat, including model-dependent sensitivity near 10^20 W.
